method: Actual combat engine, all 258 profiles before/after, nine controlled scenarios, with and without real faction support, fixed seed 91731 and 0.1 s steps. Synthetic stationary billion-HP targets isolate armor, immunity, evasion, flight, boss control and spacing. Terminal specialists run for 20 s; other profiles run for 10 s. Each source uses its real attacks, abilities, cooldowns, reloads and source attribution. The wounded synthetic keep starts at 20 HP to observe recovery; no live results are uploaded.
limitations: Synthetic arenas are not acquired campaigns and do not establish player win rates or full balance parity.
Short fixed windows include burst timing and seeded chance variance; expected damage alone does not measure support utility.
Approved cone, Heat, critical, broad Ricochet and acquisition buffs are retained; no unapproved retuning is applied.
